text: {"lessons":["Selling after modest gains can feel reassuring, but I should consider my long-term plan rather than automatically taking profits quickly.","Holding losing positions without reassessing them can let losses linger; I should review the reasons for owning each stock, not just its average cost.","A few months of account gains or declines are not enough to judge my decisions, so I should check my portfolio periodically and make deliberate, consistent choices."]}
